selected_evidence.summary: Shows `datauser`, `/srv/data`, the 100M hard limit, and direct rejection of an over-limit write.
Shows ext4 mounted with `usrquota`, persistent fstab configuration, and quota activation in Alpine’s default boot runlevel.
Captures healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered quota/data state, and successful post-restart enforcement with final cleanup.
